data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Darra lies in its association with strength, resilience, and unwavering faith. In Islamic tradition, mountains are often used as metaphors for the unchanging nature of God and the unyielding nature of faith. Just as mountains remain steadfast and unshakable despite the passage of time and natural calamities, a person named Darra is reminded to keep their faith firm and unwavering in the face of life's challenges. Additionally, the name may also have connotations of protection and security, as mountains can provide shelter and refuge from the elements and from enemies. Ultimately, the name Darra serves as a reminder of the enduring power and strength that comes from a deep and unwavering faith in God.
